---
# BLEA FSx for ONTAP Use Cases

> AWS CDK use-case templates for guest systems on Baseline Environment on AWS (BLEA),
> built around Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP as enterprise file storage. Four
> independent use cases cover file-data analytics through S3 Access Points with AWS Glue
> and Amazon Athena, multi-layered cyber resilience for financial and public-sector
> workloads, FlexCache-based distributed access between a headquarters origin and branch
> caches, and a shared-storage modernization platform offering several selectable compute
> patterns. The deliverable is the CDK/TypeScript code plus its documentation; templates
> deploy into the reader's own AWS account and are intended for upstream contribution to
> BLEA.

## How to read this repository

The repository is a TypeScript npm workspace (CDK v2). Each use case lives under
`usecases/<name>/` with its own `bin/`, `lib/`, `test/`, and `doc/`, and shares common
constructs, the ONTAP REST API custom resource, scripts, and templates from `shared/`.
`npm ci` then `npm run build` and `npm test` build and test every workspace; `npx cdk synth`
inside a use-case directory produces its template without deploying anything.

The naming convention is deliberate: write **Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP** on first mention
and **FSx for ONTAP** thereafter, and **S3 Access Points** in full. The repository's
conventions and the output rules coding agents follow are in `AGENTS.md`.

## Entry points

- [README (English)](README.md): Primary hub. Overview of the four use cases, the build and
  test commands, the shared modules, and the upstream contribution targets.
- [README (Japanese)](README_ja.md): Japanese hub with the same scope.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Conventions, naming and neutrality rules, and build/test commands
  for coding agents.
- [Use-case selection guide (Japanese)](doc/usecase-selection-guide.md): A decision tree that
  maps a customer's starting problem to one of the four use cases, plus combination patterns
  by customer type.

## Use cases

- [Data Analytics — README (English)](usecases/blea-guest-fsxn-data-analytics-sample/doc/README.md)
  ([Japanese](usecases/blea-guest-fsxn-data-analytics-sample/doc/README_ja.md)): Enterprise
  file storage on FSx for ONTAP integrated with AWS Glue and Amazon Athena through
  S3 Access Points, enabling SQL analysis of file data without duplicating it.
- [FlexCache Distributed Access — README (English)](usecases/blea-guest-fsxn-flexcache-sample/doc/README.md)
  ([Japanese](usecases/blea-guest-fsxn-flexcache-sample/doc/README_ja.md)): A FlexCache
  pattern that accelerates file access between a headquarters origin and branch-office caches,
  giving distributed users local SSD performance over VPC peering.
- [Modernization Platform — README (English)](usecases/blea-guest-fsxn-modernization-sample/doc/README.md)
  ([Japanese](usecases/blea-guest-fsxn-modernization-sample/doc/README_ja.md)): FSx for ONTAP
  as a shared-storage foundation for VMware/on-premises migration, with EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda,
  and AWS Batch compute patterns selectable via `parameter.ts`.
- [Cyber Resilience — README (English)](usecases/guest-fsxn-cyber-resilience-sample/doc/README.md)
  ([Japanese](usecases/guest-fsxn-cyber-resilience-sample/doc/README_ja.md)): A multi-layered
  ransomware-defense pattern using FSx for ONTAP native security features across a
  multi-account architecture, aimed at financial and public-sector workloads.

## Architecture and reference docs

- [NFS/SMB encryption guide (Japanese)](usecases/blea-guest-fsxn-data-analytics-sample/doc/nfs-smb-encryption-guide.md):
  Steps to enable NFS and SMB in-transit encryption on the deployed FSx for ONTAP environment,
  addressing the Government Cloud "encryption in transit" requirement.
- [Cyber resilience architecture explainer (Japanese)](usecases/guest-fsxn-cyber-resilience-sample/doc/reference-arc-fsxn-cyber-resilience/fsxn-cyber-resilience-arch-readme.md):
  How the multi-layered defense is structured and the business problem it addresses.
- [FISC mapping (Japanese)](usecases/guest-fsxn-cyber-resilience-sample/doc/reference-arc-fsxn-cyber-resilience/fisc-mapping-fsxn-cyber-resilience.md):
  How controls in the cyber-resilience use case map to the FISC security guidelines.
- [Shared modules — README (Japanese)](shared/README.md): The reusable CDK constructs, the
  ONTAP REST API custom resource, scripts, and templates shared across all four use cases.

> **Cyber resilience note**: The cyber-resilience use case can create immutable
> (SnapLock / WORM) and retention-governed resources. The documents above are linked only to
> explain the architecture, not as "deploy this" instructions. A SnapLock or WORM/retention
> feature removes the ability to delete data for a fixed period and is routinely wider in
> blast radius than the single resource named — enable one only under an explicit human
> instruction that names the retention value, after reading the teardown documentation.

## Hub / related

This repository is a spoke of the FSx for ONTAP adoption knowledge base. Start at the hub to
reach the broader lifecycle- and topic-oriented knowledge and the workload entry map.

  LLM-facing map of the hub repository.
- [Workload entry map (Japanese)](https://github.com/Yoshiki0705/FSx-for-ONTAP-Adoption-Playbook/blob/main/docs/ja/reference/workload-entry-map.md):
